verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const f="app/manage-emails/manage-form.tsx",u="app/unsubscribe/page.tsx";for(const p of [f,u]){if(!fs.existsSync(p)){console.error("SCAN-733: missing "+p);process.exit(79)}}const form=/key:\s*.matches./.test(fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8"));const page=/^\s*matches:\s*./m.test(fs.readFileSync(u,"utf8"));if(!form||!page){console.error("SCAN-733: the manage-emails form has no label for the matches category, so the housing match row is built then dropped and a member cannot turn match emails off or back on from the page that says it manages their email.");process.exit(1)}'

append.detail: CATEGORY_LABELS in app/manage-emails/manage-form.tsx had no entry for the matches category while lib/notifications/wired.ts wires matches to email, and the render returns null for a category without a label, so page.tsx built the matches row and the form silently dropped it; app/unsubscribe/page.tsx had the same gap and fell back to the raw key. Added a matches entry to both label tables (Roommate matches, the name the settings form, search destinations and the match email already use; the unsubscribe confirm reads roommate match alerts). Pinned by app/manage-emails/manage-form.test.tsx, which fails when any email-wired category lacks a label and checks the form renders a switch per email-wired category, and by a new case in app/unsubscribe/page.test.tsx that a matches token confirms with the plain label, not the key.
